bibl.seg: Antti Marjanen, Ivan Miroshnikov & Erja Salmenkivi, with a contribution by Ágnes T. Mihálykó, Coptica Fennica. Catalog of the Coptic Manuscripts from the Ilves Collection Exhibited at the National Archives of Finland (16 June - 14 August 2020) = Papyrologica Bruxellensia. 42.
Bruxelles, Association Égyptologique Reine Élisabeth (Diffusion: Peeters, Leuven - Paris - Bristol, CT), 2023, 153 pp., figg. ISBN 978-90-429-5271-3. €40.
